title: Academic collocation and word families
source: Language Learning Hub · original V4.4 teaching draft, not an external textbook
goal: Apply academic collocation and word families in an original academic-English context and explain reasoning in coherent English
context: 学习学术词族与搭配，优先掌握可直接使用的表达组合。
grammar: analyse/analysis/analytical 各有句法位置；conduct an analysis、draw a conclusion、pose a question 是常见组合。派生形式不是简单加词尾，注意不可数与可数用法。
common_mistake: make a research 通常不自然；用 conduct research 或 carry out a study。

reading: The team conducted research into the use of shared workspaces. Its analysis focused on the tasks people completed rather than the number of desks occupied. An analytical approach required clear categories and consistent observation. The findings raised a question about how collaboration should be measured. They did not justify drawing a conclusion about every workplace. Learning these expressions as combinations helps writers produce accurate sentences without searching for a different synonym each time.
